summary: Iteration 2 — Regression + new-feature test pass on preview env. Added 11 new pytest cases (affiliate redirect / clicks, withdrawal payout auto-fill + payout_info + user_mobile, mark-paid with proof+UTR, banners CRUD & visibility, refer-earn settings + credit on referred signup, affiliate link normalization). Total 37/37 pytest pass. UI smoke covered: home (zero-badge, strip, team, whatsapp-float), public /campaigns with 8 category-tiles, customer login → dashboard (refer-earn-card with signup ref link, count=2 earned=₹40, offer-banners carousel with image), /campaign/choice-trade-test (referral-link-input = `${origin}/api/go/choice-trade-test?ref=RTA12499`, referral-clicks=7), admin login → /admin (referral-bonus-setting + presets 0/10/20/50 + custom + save all present), /admin/banners (title, subtitle, link, order, add, upload, toggle-<id>, delete-<id> all present), /admin/withdrawals (5 wd-payout cards, 4 UPI + 1 acc, 2 mark-paid buttons → MarkPaidDialog with upload+utr+confirm). Customer /withdrawals shows UTR + View proof link for paid rows. All redirects work: /api/go/choice-trade-test?ref=RTA12499 → 302 to external offertracking.in; unknown slug → 302 to /campaigns.

minor.issue: Requires auth (Depends(get_current_user)); public dashboard/home won't see banners while logged out. Not blocking since banners are shown on the customer dashboard (behind login), but if design intends public exposure the dependency should be optional.
Only /admin serves the dashboard; navigating to /admin/dashboard logs a react-router warning 'No routes matched location'. Consider adding an alias/redirect.
